title: hardnormly
description: hardnormly is a VCF normalization and hard filtering toolkit for whole-exome sequencing variant processing. It normalizes variants through multiallelic splitting and left-alignment, annotates genomic regions, and applies caller-specific hard filters through a standalone command-line tool and a Snakemake workflow.
